title: Stroke rehabilitation debt-for-health allocation: data and code deposit
description: Companion data and code deposit for Paper 3 (policy / Debt-to-Health) of the stroke rehabilitation demand research programme (15 economies, 2010-2023). Computes the market-failure targeting index Gap = D - S, three debt-for-health allocation scenarios, dose-response, and physiotherapist-workforce costing. See README.md for file-level documentation. Random seed 3407.
